content:
Not if you mean decimal numbers. 9.11 is less than 9.9.

- Think of money: $9.11 vs $9.90 — $9.90 is more.
- Or compare 9.11 to 9.90 by padding zeros; 9.90 > 9.11.
- Equivalently, multiply by 100: 911 vs 990 ⇒ 990 is larger.

However, if you’re comparing software version numbers (major.minor), then 9.11 would be greater than 9.9 because 11 > 9 in the minor component.
